extraction_notes: Target identity retained exactly from job metadata: CJ3400, Jiangsu Changjing Electronics Technology Co Ltd, n-channel MOSFET.
The supplied three-page PDF identifies CJ3400 as an N-Channel Enhancement Mode Field Effect Transistor. The footer provides A, Dec, 2010, used as the revision field.

RDS(on) table rows are transcribed as inclusive maximum values: 35 mOhm at VGS = 10 V and ID = 5.8 A, 40 mOhm at VGS = 4.5 V and ID = 5 A, and 52 mOhm at VGS = 2.5 V and ID = 4 A; all are pulse-test rows with pulse width <= 300 us and duty cycle <= 2%.
The threshold table provides MIN = 0.7 V and MAX = 1.4 V at VDS = VGS and ID = 250 uA; no typical threshold value is printed.

Ciss = 1050 pF MAX has no printed bias or frequency condition in its table cell. Coss = 99 pF TYP and Crss = 77 pF TYP retain the explicitly printed VDS = 15 V, VGS = 0 V, f = 1 MHz condition. Capacitances are converted to farads.

The strict schema has no fields for IDSS, IGSS, forward transconductance, gate resistance, switching times, absolute maximum ratings, or thermal resistance. The supplied tables additionally publish IDSS MAX = 1 uA at VDS = 24 V and VGS = 0 V, IGSS MAX = +/-100 nA at VGS = +/-12 V and VDS = 0 V, gFS MIN = 8 S at VDS = 5 V and ID = 5 A, Rg MAX = 3.6 ohm at VDS = 0 V, VGS = 0 V, f = 1 MHz, switching maxima td(on) = 5 ns, tr = 7 ns, td(off) = 40 ns, tf = 6 ns, and maximum ratings VDS = 30 V, VGS = +/-12 V, ID = 5.8 A, IDM = 30 A, PD = 0.35 W, RthetaJA = 357 degC/W, TJ = 150 degC, and TSTG = -55 to +150 degC; p. 1-2 citations.

The p. 3 output plot labels the high-current family as VGS = 7 V to 3 V; those traces are clipped by the 24 A plot ceiling and were not digitized as separate curves. The VGS = 1.5 V, 2 V, and 2.5 V traces, transfer trace, RDS(on) traces, and body-diode trace are included.
Curve points are compact direct readings from the supplied typical plots on p. 3. No points were generated by interpolation between source values.
The supplied PDF contains no capacitance-versus-VDS figure, so no capacitance curve points were invented.
